summary: Iteration 2 testing: Backend 8/8 new tests + 15/15 existing tests pass. Frontend mostly works but two real bugs found. (1) Backend: GET /api/stories audio_events all include audio_url; /api/subscriptions/status returns correct shape with premium=false, free_story_limit=3, monthly+yearly plans; /api/subscriptions/start with plan_id='monthly' or 'yearly' flips premium=true; teacher RBAC fully working (login, create class, add student, create assignment, get analytics, parent gets 403). (2) Frontend: teacher signup TEACHER ACCOUNT banner shown; teacher login routes to /teacher/dashboard with Demo Teacher greeting + 3 stat tiles + pre-seeded 'Grade 3 - Sundaram' class; class detail loads with Assign-story sheet + add-student card; 'Assign story' bottom sheet opens and selecting a story closes sheet and adds it to Assignments list; /subscription page shows Monthly ₹199 + Yearly ₹1499, tap Yearly toggles button to 'Subscribe yearly', tap Subscribe shows 'You're a Shravan member' success state; story detail shows 'Start reading aloud'. BUGS: (a) Teacher tab bar shows a 4th 'classes/[id]' tab — `href: null` is not sufficient on expo-router web for a nested-path Tabs.Screen. (b) Home FEATURED STORY 'Open story' tap does not navigate (URL stays on /home); navigation works only via Library tab. (c) Free-stories-remaining count is NOT visible below 'Start reading aloud' button on story detail (could not 100% confirm cause — demo user became premium during /subscription UI test, so count is correctly hidden for premium; needs re-test with a fresh non-premium parent to validate count rendering for free-tier users).

ui_bugs.issue: A 4th tab labelled 'classes/[id]' is visible in the bottom tab bar on /teacher/dashboard and /teacher/classes/[id]. `<Tabs.Screen name="classes/[id]" options={{ href: null }} />` does NOT hide nested-path Tabs.Screen entries on expo-router web. Need to also set `tabBarItemStyle: { display: 'none' }` and/or `tabBarButton: () => null`, OR restructure `classes` to a Stack (classes/_layout.tsx with Stack, classes/index.tsx + classes/[id].tsx) so the dynamic route doesn't sit as a sibling Tabs.Screen.

Tapping 'Open story' (and the surrounding pill) on the FEATURED STORY card on /home does not navigate — URL stays at /home. The onPress is attached to a Body (Text) component inside a styled View; the View itself is not pressable, so taps on the pill background do not fire. Wrap the pill (or the entire featured card) in <Pressable> or <TouchableOpacity> with onPress routing to `/story/{featured.id}`. Library tap-to-open works correctly, so this is isolated to the home featured card.

integration_issues.issue: Spec says 'Below [Start reading aloud] the count of free stories remaining is shown'. Could not verify because the demo@shravan.in account was promoted to premium during the /subscription UI test (subscriptions/start endpoint sets premium_until). Re-test with a freshly-signed-up parent (or reset demo user's premium_until in db) to confirm whether the free-count UI string renders. The endpoint /api/subscriptions/status returns the correct fields; the frontend just needs to display them on the story page for non-premium users.

issues: Bottom tab bar overlaps the 'Add student' submit button when keyboard / form is open — needs bottom padding or scrollable container to keep button above tab bar height (64px).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still emitted on every page load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Library-level (expo-router/safe-area), non-blocking but should be tracked.

action_items: Fix teacher tab bar: hide `classes/[id]` route from Tabs. Either add `tabBarButton: () => null` and `tabBarItemStyle: { display: 'none' }` to its options, or restructure classes into a Stack layout (recommended) so dynamic routes are not siblings of tab routes.

Fix home featured card navigation: wrap 'Open story' pill (or whole featured card) in <Pressable>/<TouchableOpacity> with onPress={() => router.push(`/story/${featured.id}`)}. Currently only the Body text has onPress, so the pill area is dead.

Verify and surface 'free stories remaining' count below the Start-reading-aloud button on /story/[id] for non-premium parents. Test with a freshly-signed-up parent (the demo user is now premium because /api/subscriptions/start was invoked during UI testing).
Add `keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'` and bottom padding ≥ 80px to the ScrollView on /teacher/classes/[id] so the 'Add student' button is not hidden behind the tab bar.
Optional: reset demo@shravan.in `premium_until` field in DB if tests expect it to be a free-tier account by default (or test premium-related flows with a separate seeded account).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now ~995 lines; should be split into routers (auth, stories, subscriptions, classes, speech).
EVENT_AUDIO_URLS hotlinks to pixabay CDN — fine for dev, but for production a CDN you control is recommended (pixabay URLs occasionally rotate).

/api/subscriptions/start currently has no idempotency guard; calling it twice extends premium_until by another 30/365 days each time. Consider checking existing premium_until before extending, or storing a stripe-style payment_id.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded everywhere via projections / pop.
All env vars (MONGO_URL, JWT_SECRET, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) read from env without hardcoded defaults — good.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (10/12 review-request flows worked; 2 UI bugs found: teacher tab bar extra 'classes/[id]' tab, home FEATURED 'Open story' non-tappable)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Class_e123e7 (teacher class) + TEST_Kid student + 1 assignment (Brave Tiger) via pytest. Created 2 ephemeral parents (test_sub_*, test_sub2_*) for subscription tests. NOTE: demo@shravan.in was upgraded to premium via /api/subscriptions/start during UI testing — main agent may want to reset this in DB for clean retesting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py + test_shravan_api.py. Run: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL='https://shravan-read.preview.emergentagent.com' pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Key UI selectors: teacher dashboard data-testid pattern unknown (used text selectors). To repro the tab-bar bug: log in as teacher@shravan.in / Teacher@1234 → look at bottom tab bar on any /teacher/* screen → 4 tabs visible instead of 3. To repro home featured nav bug: log in as parent → /home → tap 'Open story' on the orange FEATURED card → URL does not change. Library → Brave Tiger card → /story/{id} works correctly. demo@shravan.in is now PREMIUM in db (premium_until set ~365 days out) from this test run; reset before retesting free-tier flows.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (teacher tab bar): expo-router on web renders every <Tabs.Screen> as a tab even with `href: null`; that prop only blocks navigation, not visual rendering of the tab button. RCA: missing `tabBarButton: () => null` or `tabBarItemStyle: { display: 'none' }`. Bug 2 (home Open story not tappable): only the inner Body Text has onPress; the wrapping View pill has no Pressable. RCA: tap-area mismatch — user taps the pill background which has no event handler attached.
